name: Doppio Malto
note: Proposed rating: none. The doppiomalto.com footer attributes the brand to FoodBrand S.p.A.; Il Giorno (21 Nov 2023) calls Giovanni Porcu CEO of FoodBrand S.p.A., which includes Doppio Malto; retail&food (14 Dec 2023) states Doppio Malto belongs 100% to Porcu, and Tottus in Pari (18 Jan 2023) calls him sole shareholder, president and CEO of the chain.
